problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Establish multi-step verification for financial transactions
Monitor email accounts for unusual sending patterns

problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage buckets or services exposing sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users, leading to data breaches or leakage.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access controls and role-based access
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Adversaries compromise software or hardware suppliers to insert malicious code or backdoors, impacting downstream customers and organizations.
risk_reduction: Conduct thorough vendor risk assessments and continuous monitoring
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and integrity verification
Use zero trust principles for supply chain access

problems.description: Attackers craft inputs to machine learning models that cause misclassification or erroneous outputs, undermining AI-driven security or business systems.
risk_reduction: Use robust ML model training with adversarial examples
Implement input validation and anomaly detection on ML pipelines
Continuously monitor model performance and retrain as needed

problems.description: Use of AI to generate highly convincing phishing messages or deepfake content to increase success rates of social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools to identify synthetic content
Enhance user awareness training with examples of AI-generated attacks
Implement multi-factor authentication to reduce credential theft impact

problems.description: Ransomware operations offered as a service to affiliates, lowering the barrier for attackers and increasing ransomware incidents.
risk_reduction: Maintain regular offline backups and test restoration processes
Implement network segmentation and endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Apply timely patching and vulnerability management
